_what: Tables that are DELIBERATELY deny-all — RLS enabled with no select-capable policy — each with the reason it is closed. Asserted by scripts/verify-select-policies.mjs.
_why_a_declaration_and_not_a_fix: Deny-all is fail-closed and is a legitimate design for server-only reference data that no client ever reads. It is NOT a legitimate ACCIDENT — and the accident is exactly what bit this platform three times (modules 2026-05-22, nursery_modules 2026-05-22, orders 2026-05-27), each time invisibly, because an empty surface under RLS looks identical to an empty table. This file is what tells a deliberate closure apart from a forgotten policy.
_the_bar: An entry is admissible only if (a) NO client path reads the table — verified by grep, not asserted — and (b) the reason is recorded in the table's own migration, not invented here. Both entries below meet both.
_this_list_prunes_itself: The cap asserts these in the OTHER direction too: a declaration for a table that no longer exists, or that has since gained a select-capable policy, is STALE and FAILS THE BUILD. That is deliberate. verify-universals' OWNER_ONLY_PENDING is a hardcoded gap list that only grows, six of nine entries are now stale, and it prints on every run — which is how a gap list stops being read (tech-debt #73). A list that cannot rot is the fix.
_added: 2026-08-01 — the cap that closes CLAUDE.md Open Architecture Decision #11, whose own trigger fired at least three times with nothing behind it.

declarations.platform_config: Operator infrastructure config (OCR model names, feature flags) — NOT tenant data. The migration says so at its head: 'AC-2: No authenticated-user SELECT policy intentionally — this is operator config, not tenant data. Service key (server-side) bypasses RLS. No client-side read path.' VERIFIED 2026-08-01: exactly one reader in the whole repo, packages/cultivar-os/api/receipts/ocr.ts:170, and it constructs its own SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY client. An authenticated browser session must NOT be able to read or write this table. Home: supabase/migrations/20260611_platform_config.sql.
declarations.permission_aliases: Migration-window equivalence between the legacy permission vocabulary and resource:verb (spec v3 §8). Read ONLY by the resolver under SECURITY DEFINER, which bypasses RLS; the migration additionally REVOKEs ALL from public/authenticated/anon, so the closure is belt-and-braces and deliberate: 'No client ever needs it, so nothing is granted to authenticated — the table is closed.' VERIFIED 2026-08-01: zero client readers in the repo. ⚠️ THIS ENTRY IS EXPECTED TO BECOME STALE BY DELETION — the table is dropped at Phase 7 CONTRACT behind two zero-checks, and when it goes the cap will report this declaration as stale and fail until the entry is removed. That is the list working, not a defect. Home: supabase/migrations/20260726_permission_alias_layer.sql.
